title: Caleb Williams: I'll miss D.J. Moore personally, understand trading him was business

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Caleb Williams: I'll miss D.J. Moore personally, understand trading him was business
sources.description: "You build up a relationship on a personal level and it sucks that he has to go," Williams said. "I'm excited for him the rest of his career to see what he does."
